race.comment: NARBOLD (12) comes here in peak condition on the quick back-up after he loomed strongly only to go under in a tight finish when second over 1600m at Randwick last Saturday. Drops 5.5kg on the limit and will relish the fast tempo. Can put them away in this stronger race. RUN HARRY RUN (2) good fresh gelding who pulled out plenty with the 59kg to score in a tight finish over 1400m at Mildura first-up. Consistent type who will take catching again from the low draw. IT'S A KNOCKOUT (10) jumps in grade and trip fourth-up and sets up well with the 52kg. Closed strongly from the wide draw with an unlucky second over 1400m at Randwick. Will appreciate the early speed and look for her swooping late. EMIRATE (11) racing with a lot more consistency this prep and undefeated in two starts over this trip. Never at home on the heavy surface when eighth last start over the 1400m at Randwick. Can return to winning form. PUNCH LANE (1) classy gelding who looks to have another win in him this prep.
